cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

confusable: D20 finds hope after setbacks; D17 advocates a bad prospective plan as sensible and unavoidable.
comparison: Physical business plan versus event finance.
seedUse: D17-a converts predictable weather harm into alleged financial responsibility.
